title: Blog API
description: Build a blog API with posts, comments, and pagination support.

steps.title: Create a post
steps.description: Create a POST /posts endpoint that accepts JSON with "title" and "content", assigns an id, and returns 201.
hints: Use app.post('/posts', handler) with express.json() middleware

codeTemplate.python:
from fastapi import FastAPI
from pydantic import BaseModel
import os

app = FastAPI()
port = int(os.getenv('PORT', 3000))

class PostIn(BaseModel):
    title: str
    content: str

class Comment(BaseModel):
    id: int
    text: str

class Post(BaseModel):
    id: int
    title: str
    content: str
    comments: list[Comment] = []

posts = []
next_id = 1

@app.post('/posts', status_code=201)
def create_post(post: PostIn):
    global next_id
    new_post = Post(id=next_id, title=post.title, content=post.content)
    next_id += 1
    posts.append(new_post)
    return new_post

codeTemplate.python:
from fastapi import FastAPI
from pydantic import BaseModel
import os

app = FastAPI()
port = int(os.getenv('PORT', 3000))

class PostIn(BaseModel):
    title: str
    content: str

class Comment(BaseModel):
    id: int
    text: str

class Post(BaseModel):
    id: int
    title: str
    content: str
    comments: list[Comment] = []

posts = []
next_id = 1

@app.post('/posts', status_code=201)
def create_post(post: PostIn):
    global next_id
    new_post = Post(id=next_id, title=post.title, content=post.content)
    next_id += 1
    posts.append(new_post)
    return new_post

@app.get('/posts')
def list_posts(page: int = 1, limit: int = 10):
    start = (page - 1) * limit
    data = posts[start:start + limit]
    return {'data': data, 'page': page, 'totalCount': len(posts)}
